R7AC-grouse-drive-0001.name: By Milk River
R7AC-grouse-drive-0001.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a paved road (estimate).
R7AC-grouse-drive-0001.parkWhat: pull off on Goat/Milk FSR (paved road)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
4 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
37 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 7A table (page 57), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). MU 7-1 is listed in Region 7A on page 2 but no row names it.

plan: Drive: from Village of Valemount, about 145 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 53.34782, -120.68577, pull off on Goat/Milk FSR (paved road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the Goat/Milk FSR stretch, 4.9 km one way. About 99 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-5, Region 7A. Season: grouse dusky (blue) grouse Sept 1 to Nov 15 and more rows (synopsis page 57, 99%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AC-grouse-drive-0001.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 7-5: about 2,410 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.79 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
